scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @ludo-rush/server" "npm run dev -w @ludo-rush/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ludo-rush/shared && npm run build -w @ludo-rush/server && npm run build -w @ludo-rush/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ludo-rush/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ludo-rush/server && npm run typecheck -w @ludo-rush/client
